verdict_text: YES. The script verifies identical tensor names via `set` equality and checks bit-exact equality of every non-MLP tensor across all three checkpoints before any merging, aborting via `assert` if violated (satisfying Required checks item 1). It computes the merge for exactly the 64 MLP tensors (matched by the given regex) using `base + λ(ft1-base) + λ(ft2-base)` with λ=0.4, both task vectors taken against the unmodified `base` dict (no ordering hazard), in float32 then cast back to the base dtype. It asserts `merged == 64` and `len(out) == 244` before writing, and writes a single `out/T4/model.safetensors` with all 244 tensors, non-MLP ones taken unchanged from base.
